intro: The High Elder's Request sends adventurers to consult with High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar following coordinated assaults on the region's watchtowers. Reports from the western watchtower indicate that a hostile cult is targeting the local anchor pylons.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The attacks on both the western and eastern watchtowers are not a coincidence. Based on what you told us about what occurred at the western watchtower with that skypriest, our best guess is that the cult is trying to do something to the anchor pylons.
Please speak with High Elder Shadowsong. He will tell you about a lead that could prove to be promising.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I have a small matter that requires just the kind of assistance that an adventurer like yourself can provide.
